t: What Liquid Metal Grid Batteries Is
title: What Liquid Metal Grid Batteries Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Liquid metal batteries store energy in molten metals: three liquid layers (two metals, one salt) that self-segregate — no membranes, no degradation, 20-year life — for ultra-cheap long-duration grid storage. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Liquid Metal Grid Batteries: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Liquid Metal Grid Batteries in one line: Liquid metal batteries store energy in molten metals: three liquid layers (two metals, one salt) that self-segregate — no membranes, no degradation, 20-year life — for ultra-cheap long-duration grid storage.
Why it matters: Liquids cannot crack or degrade; the battery that lasts decades with no maintenance..
Where it is used: long-duration grid storage, renewable firming, industrial backup..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
